limitations: One scope and two children; replacement is permanent retirement of that scope. No arbitrary interleaving or whole-session refinement claim.

Readiness, timeout observation and logical cleanup progress require the explicit fairness assumptions. Child-destruction requests do not acknowledge exit; physical quiescence requires independent termination observations and has its own conditional progress property and no-fairness counterexample.

OS scheduling, real deadline bounds, Android instrumentation, durable private-file publication, secret redaction and physical-device performance are outside the finite proof. Existing JVM and loopback contracts exercise those relevant implementation boundaries within controlled conditions.
